title: AgentResponse
description: Response from the Gemini agent runner after processing a user message

text.description: Natural language response from Gemini to display to the user
examples: Done! I've added 'Buy groceries' to your task list.
Hello! I'm TaskBot, your friendly todo manager. How can I help you today?
I'm a bit busy right now. Please try again in a moment!

tool_calls.description: List of all tools executed during this request (may be empty)

conversation_id.description: Optional conversation ID for persistence tracking

ToolCallRecord.description: Record of a single tool invocation

name.description: Name of the tool that was executed

arguments.description: Arguments passed to the tool (always includes user_id)

result.description: JSON result returned by the tool execution

status.description: Outcome status of the tool execution

examples.text: Hello! I'm TaskBot, your friendly todo manager. How can I help you today?
Done! I've added 'Buy groceries' to your task list.

Here are your tasks:

1. Buy groceries (pending)
2. Finish report (completed)
I couldn't find that task. Want me to show you your current list?

result.message: Task not found or does not belong to user

examples.text: I'm a bit busy right now. Please try again in a moment!
